name: Whisper TikTok Demo
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: Discover Whisper-TikTok, an innovative AI-powered tool that leverages the prowess of Edge TTS, OpenAI-Whisper, and FFMPEG to craft captivating TikTok videos. Harnessing the capabilities of OpenAI's Whisper model, Whisper-TikTok effortlessly generates an accurate transcription from provided audio files, laying the foundation for the creation of mesmerizing TikTok videos through the utilization of FFMPEG. Additionally, the program seamlessly integrates the Microsoft Edge Cloud Text-to-Speech (TTS) API to lend a vibrant voiceover to the video. Opting for Microsoft Edge Cloud TTS API's voiceover…
